regions.merged_text: You and yours. Many thanks from myself and our whole community for your generous donation of fruit received in perfect condition, - two fine big eratis shiped March 17th (Irish holy-day! ), and four fine baskets March 22nd. May our dear Lord bless yourself - as also everyone who in any way has been interested. · . What a privilege to do a favor for God in doing for our neighbor! The same too can be said of being appreciative and grateful for such favor - Communion of saints.
